meta.title: Flower garden
meta.description: Adds a Flower garden tab to the session view tabs next to Chat and Trajectory: four grounds (meadow, snowfield, volcanic crater, lakeside) holding twenty-five real flowers, each drawn from its actual shape. Plant a seed, water the soil, harvest the bloom into the basket, then sell it or fill a bouquet order for a better price. Every flower has a flower-book entry per colour: a plain bloom, a second natural colour that odd-numbered plots grow, and a rare gold bloom that appears with 3%-30% odds — likelier when the plant never dried out, when you harvest in that ground's favoured weather, right after watering, or at night. Four shop items add depth: fertiliser jumps a flower 25% forward, a sprinkler waters a whole ground for 30 minutes, a lucky charm adds 25% to the next harvest's spirit chance, and a basket upgrade adds six slots. Coins open the other grounds (150 / 450 / 1200) and three extra plots each; weather turns every five minutes and each ground reads it differently (meadow sun grows 15% faster, snow keeps the soil wet, crater ash neither waters nor warms). Growth pauses while the soil is dry and a plot keeps growing while the tab is closed. The garden is saved in this browser for the running profile and shared by every session; it involves no model request, tool call, session-log write, or network access, and turning the plugin off only hides the tab.
